data.title: Bitcoin Cash vs Litecoin: Which Payment Coin Has More Upside in 2026?
data.description: CME futures launched, ETF filings hit the SEC, and two rival payment coins are pulling in opposite directions heading into year-end. One of them just made a 46% move in a single week, and the other can barely attract a dollar of ETF inflows.
